failingTestName: ADR 0013 repair scope: exactly three production files, by exact path > edited no ADR that already existed

rootCauseInFull.whatChangedInRepairDid: git diff --name-only <REPAIR_BASE_COMMIT> -- docs/adr, from the base commit to the WORKING TREE
rootCauseInFull.theDefect: A name-only diff lists an ADDED path exactly as it lists a MODIFIED one, so the assertion could not express its own title. ADR 0013 was added deliberately by the repair, therefore the assertion necessarily reported it and necessarily failed.
rootCauseInFull.thePremiseThatWasWrong: The comment beside the assertion claimed a new ADR 'does not appear in a diff of tracked files at all'. A newly tracked path DOES appear in git diff --name-only.

whyNot: The defect is in repair-scope bookkeeping in a test file. It touches no runtime behaviour, no persisted evidence, no policy boundary and no fetch outcome. Both revalidation targets issued and persisted their continuation request correctly.

changeOne.repairBaseCommitSubject: docs(2b): the Batch-02 v2 continuation execution record
changeOne.repairTerminalCommitSubject: feat(2b): Option C-lite - one same-registrable-domain robots redirect
changeOne.why: The Option-C-lite repair is history. Its own header already said that its terminal commit must be pinned once that happened. An unpinned range would make a landed phase's isolation test police every later phase forever, which is exactly the failure mode the A1, A1b, A3a, F7 and Option-B ranges were pinned to avoid.

changeTwo.provesA: No pre-existing ADR was modified, deleted or renamed: an M, D or R line under docs/adr would make the exact-equality assertion fail.
changeTwo.provesB: Exactly ADR 0013 was newly added: a missing A line, a different A line, or a second A line all fail the same assertion.
changeTwo.whyExactEqualityRatherThanTwoDiffFilters: One exact name-status assertion states the WHOLE changeset under docs/adr rather than two partial views of it, so there is no third change class either filter could miss.
changeTwo.whyRenameDetectionMatters: Without --find-renames a renamed predecessor ADR could present as an unrelated delete plus add; with it, the R line is visible and fails the assertion.

changeThree.detail: The skip gate was renamed baseAvailable -> rangeAvailable and now requires BOTH the base and the terminal commit to exist, so a shallow clone skips the range assertions rather than reading half a range.

correctionApplied.formattingOnlyFollowUp: npx prettier --write on the same single file, to satisfy the repository's own format:check gate.

scopeDiscipline.howProven: git diff --name-only HEAD -- src/orgunits src/cli src/db src/ingest src/website src/compare src/config migrations docs/adr docs/evaluation src/test/firewall returned EMPTY. The only tracked modification against HEAD 9493073 was the single test file.
